source_references.author: Mitchell Hashimoto
source_references.evidence_scope: Describes decomposing large projects into demonstrable milestones, building runnable slices early, and learning through dogfooding.
source_references.notes: Source metadata and original paraphrase only; article language is not copied.

source_references.title: As Code
source_references.author: Mitchell Hashimoto
source_references.evidence_scope: Defines the operational benefits of inscribing rules as code: sharing, versioning, iteration, automation, and validation.
source_references.notes: Source metadata and original paraphrase only; article language is not copied.

source_references.title: Ghostty 1.0 Reflection
source_references.author: Mitchell Hashimoto
source_references.evidence_scope: Reflects on a shared portable core with platform-native interfaces, extensive dogfooding, and staged work toward a public release.
source_references.notes: Source metadata and original paraphrase only; project details are summarized.

principles.statement: Decompose a large technical ambition into milestones that each produce runnable, visible evidence and reduce uncertainty.
principles.evidence_note: The authored essay centers demonstrable incremental projects as the delivery strategy.

signature_moves.statement: Put an early end-to-end version into daily use so real friction guides priorities before broad release.
signature_moves.evidence_note: Both project accounts use dogfooding as a learning and quality loop.

likely_objections.statement: A fully uniform cross-platform interface can sacrifice native fit; share a portable core while preserving platform-specific surfaces where they matter.
likely_objections.evidence_note: The project reflection describes a shared core paired with native interfaces.

anti_patterns.statement: Rules kept only as manual knowledge cannot be reliably shared, versioned, automated, or validated.
anti_patterns.evidence_note: The essay derives these properties from inscribing operational rules.

context_dependencies: Apply to developer tools, infrastructure workflows, and large incremental product builds.

abstention_boundaries.reason: The selected sources focus on technical products and engineering execution.
The selected sources do not establish a durable comparative vendor ranking.

open_questions: Which project slices maximize early learning for a given risk profile?
